model.gate_as_coin: Each of the 23 gates is represented as an independent logical coin/thread identity.
model.triad_composition: Each gate-coin is composed of three independently addressable logical lanes: YIN, YANG, YONG.
model.harmony: The three lanes reconcile into one gate-level harmony state.

lane_contract.harmony: YIN + YANG + YONG -> gate harmony -> global reconciliation

flows: YIN authorizes and passes to YANG
YANG executes/settles and passes verification to YONG
Gate harmony becomes the next synchronized state
